Designed to make your YouTube experience more convenient, this app aims to reduce the hassle of manually skipping ads when you\'re busy, eating, or away from your phone. Our goal is to create a smarter, more convenient viewing experience with minimal user interaction.
To make digital content consumption more seamless, convenient, and user-friendly through practical technology solutions.
Lead Developer & Software Architect\nDedicated to building privacy-respecting, high-utility native Android applications.

Prominent Disclosure & Explicit Consent:

SkipMate uses the Android AccessibilityService API exclusively to detect when the official 'Skip Ads' button becomes clickable on YouTube's player and automatically triggers a standard click action on your behalf.

• Zero Personal Data Collection: SkipMate does NOT access, read, or record personal data, passwords, keystrokes, financial details, or video streams.
• Complete Local Offline Operation: SkipMate requires NO internet permission (android.permission.INTERNET is completely absent from the manifest) and cannot transmit data to any server.
• YouTube Terms Compliance: SkipMate does NOT block ads, strip ad content, or bypass unskippable bumper ads.
Compliant with Google Play Accessibility and User Data Policies.
